title: Two control-centre host tests do not build on Linux: GCC 15 (OrbStack
notes: Linux). Smallest action: size those buffers for the joined path (or check
the return), then rerun `tools/test-control-centre-host.sh` in the VM.
result: backlight_test.c and settings_test.c now assert each path snprintf returns less than the buffer size, so GCC's -Wformat-truncation no longer fires and a truncated path aborts the test instead of passing silently.
evidence: tools/test-control-centre-host.sh: 19/19 PASS under GCC 15.3.0 (docker gcc:15; the OrbStack taq102 VM no longer exists) and 19/19 under macOS clang; gcc-16 -Werror compiles both files clean.
